title: The following KB should be removed
description: The knowledge provided in this KB won't work: [How to Automatically Set Issue Security Level for Sub Task During Creation|https://confluence.atlassian.com/jirakb/how-to-automatically-set-issue-security-level-for-sub-task-during-creation-824349620.html].    It is expected that you can't set a issue security level to a sub-task. Sub-tasks will only inherit security levels from their parent tasks.    There are suggestions for allowing that: [JRASERVER-5869|https://<USER>atlassian.com/browse/JRASERVER-5869], [JRACLOUD-5869|https://<USER>atlassian.com/browse/JRACLOUD-5869].  Notice that they have been set as won't fix.    So an add-on should not be able to bypass that condition from Jira.
